_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY. The real per-server config lives at ~/.cowork/config.json (override with COWORK_CONFIG). On first run the server copies this file there; edit the copy, not this template. Personal host/brain settings must never be committed here.
_services_comment: Powers the Portal launcher in the web UI. Each entry needs a url; label/description/icon (a lucide icon name)/category are optional and default from a built-in catalog. Known keys (mautic, filebrowser, forgejo, firecrawl, vllm35b, grafana, portainer, n8n, …) get their metadata for free.

_obsidian_comment: Shared knowledge base every brain can query. Local brains (same host) may read vaultPath off disk directly; remote brains use GET /api/obsidian/* and the obsidian_* MCP tools. Served read-only. The Portal shows an 'Obsidian Vault' web-viewer card when enabled.

orchestration._concurrency_comment: maxConcurrent is the GLOBAL ceiling on locally-spawned runs across all brains. defaultBrainConcurrency is the per-brain fallback cap for brains without their own maxConcurrent. A brain backed by a shared inference server (the local hermes/vLLM brains) or a stateless CLI can set brains.<id>.maxConcurrent > 1 to serve several tasks at once on ONE instance; when a preferred chain rung is saturated the dispatcher load-balances the overflow onto the next local rung with spare capacity, so no single workhorse brain absorbs every task.

verifier._comment: Rejects soft failures that exit 0 (rate-limit/quota/overloaded/empty replies) so they hand over to the next fallback brain instead of being marked done. failPatterns are merged with the built-ins. Enable llm for an extra LLM quality gate that judges genuine task completion.

orchestrator.description: Decompose a CEO idea into role-tagged subtasks and dispatch them

generalist.description: Fallback when the router can't classify or an agent fails through its chain
